descriptionEn: An apartment of 92.85 m² is offered for sale, located on Rruga Pajazit Islami, Fushë Kosovë, in a modern building, built by Tehno Home.
The apartment has the following layout of interior spaces: living room & dining area, separate kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom + 1 WC, 2 balconies

Apartment floor: 6
The building in which the apartment is located is equipped with an elevator and offers sufficient space for parking.
The apartment is under construction and the works will be completed in June 2026.
The apartment is located in a developed area of Fushë Kosovë, with close access to the main roads and near schools, kindergartens, markets and the services needed for everyday life.
notes: Size on floor-plan card (92.85m2) matches the caption. Building renders 02–04 are the same Tehno Home renders used in B335 (which gives Rruga Zahir Pajaziti instead of Rruga Pajazit Islami) — possibly the same project; maintainer may want to confirm the street.
